summary: PINNED the classify projection law from the asm + live data. THE BIG CORRECTIONS to the prior model (maze-span-build.json + packages/parser/src/maze/classify.ts): (1) COORDINATE AXES were transposed. The cell index is cell = z*64 + cellA*8 + cellB where cellA = DGROUP 0x4f9e (the ×8 / high axis) and cellB = DGROUP 0x4fa0 (the ×1 / low axis). The prior finding's 'cell = z*64 + y*8 + x' labels x/y backwards: the engine's 0x4f9e field is the ×8 axis. View_render_corridor_frame loads the cursor at 0x4ad7 as {[bp-2]=gx(0x4fa4), [bp-4]=gy(0x4fa2), [bp-6]=cellA(0x4f9e)... NO}: precisely [bp-2]=0x4fa4(gx), [bp-4]=0x4fa2(gy), [bp-6]=0x4fa0(cellB), [bp-8]=0x4f9e(cellA), [bp-0xa]=0x4f9c(z); the pit-read at 0x4b16 computes ax=[bp-0xa]<<6 + [bp-8]<<3 + [bp-6] = z*64 + (0x4f9e)*8 + (0x4fa0), i.e. cell = z*64 + cellA*8 + cellB. (2) FORWARD AXIS per facing (LIVE-VERIFIED by stepping): facing0 -> +cellA (+gy); facing1 -> +cellB (+gx); facing2 -> -cellA (-gy); facing3 -> -cellB (-gx). classify.ts's FORWARD_STEP{0:[0,1],1:[1,0],2:[0,-1],3:[-1,0]} is in (x=cellB, y=cellA) order and is therefore CORRECT IF read as (dCellB, dCellA) — but its facing0=+cellA is stored as [0,1] meaning dy=+1 (y=cellA) which is right; the bug is purely in which raw field x/y bind to. (3) DEPTH INDEXING: the build depth loop (0x4c60) runs the BUILD depth counter 0x5040 = 0,1,2,3 (cmp < 0x521e=4). depthField on each emitted span = the BUILD depth counter directly. depth d looks at the cell d steps forward (party + d*forward), NOT d+1 — DEPTH 0 IS THE PARTY'S OWN CELL / immediate forward edge, which is why the lookback frame has a wt=2 span at depthField 0 (the current classify.ts d=1..4 loop cannot produce it; it must run d=0..3). (4) FORWARD/DEPTH-BOUND TEST: the loop always iterates depth 0..3 (fixed bound 4); the front classifier 0x3828(param 0) returns the forward edge code and the per-depth gate seeding decides emission — a solid forward edge stops further depth-cells from being VISIBLE (occlusion) but each depth's slot is still classified. (5) SIDE -> CELL-EDGE MAPPING: the side slots are NOT a side-edge read of the current cell; the classifier does a LATERAL view_step (0x37a7 with the side param: 0xffff=left, +1=right) to the adjacent cell, then reads that cell's FORWARD-facing wall (same edge selector as the front slot). I.e. left-side / right-side = 'is there a wall down the corridor one cell to my left / right'. (6) PARITY-ALTERNATION CORRECTION: the lookback frame proves the side-wall SPAN is emitted at EVERY depth where the corridor is BOUNDED (>=1 physical side solid), with the screen-side (left/right seam base 12/10) chosen by PARITY alternation — NOT by which physical side is solid. The lookback corridor has W[cellA,cellB+1]=2 (one solid side) and W[cellA,cellB]=0 (the OTHER side OPEN, a parallel passage), yet the engine emits a wt=2 wall at all 4 depths alternating screen-side R,L,R,L (seams 10,13,12,15 = depthField + {right:10, left:12}). classify.ts's current 'emit the parity-SELECTED side only if THAT specific side is solid' is WRONG for one-sided corridors — it would drop ~half the spans. ASYMMETRIC FRAME: reached + captured maze-corridor-asym (facing 1, one 'right' turn from the stub): slot5220 = [0,0,2,0,2] (front=open, corner-L=open, corner-R=SOLID, left-side=open, right-side=SOLID) — a clean LEFT/RIGHT-asymmetric slot frame (the symmetric straight corridors could not disambiguate left vs right). Committed as tools/libretro/states/maze-corridor-asym.state + tools/parity/fixtures/engine/maze-corridor-asym.{idx.gz,png} + a maze-frames.json entry.

findings.claim: cell index = z*64 + cellA*8 + cellB, where cellA = DGROUP 0x4f9e (×8 / high axis) and cellB = DGROUP 0x4fa0 (×1 / low axis). The prior finding's 'z*64 + y*8 + x' is correct in form but mislabels which raw field is which: the ×8 axis is 0x4f9e (prior 'x'), the ×1 axis is 0x4fa0 (prior 'y'). Each cell's fine global coords: cellA's fine coord = gy (0x4fa2), cellB's fine coord = gx (0x4fa4). The 8×8 cell grid maps fine coords via per-region base tables: maze_block+0x1e0 (gxBase per cell-region) and +0x1ec (gyBase). The 'cur_cell' at 0x4fa6 is a 12-region index (the region containing the party's fine coords) and is a RED HERRING for the wall classifier — the classifier uses cellA/cellB directly, not cur_cell.

Pit-flag cell at 0x4b16: ax=[bp-0xa]<<6; cx=[bp-8]<<3; ax+=cx; ax+=[bp-6] => cell = z*64 + (0x4f9e)*8 + (0x4fa0). Same pattern in classifier 0x38ba (cell=[bp+0xc]<<6 + [bp+0xa]<<3 + [bp+8], with the same arg order: [bp+0xc]=z, [bp+0xa]=cellA, [bp+8]=cellB). findings.claim: Forward step per facing (view_step_forward_by_facing 0x37a7 rotation): facing0 -> +cellA (gy+1); facing1 -> +cellB (gx+1); facing2 -> -cellA (gy-1); facing3 -> -cellB (gx-1). Equivalently (dCellA, dCellB): f0=(+1,0), f1=(0,+1), f2=(-1,0), f3=(0,-1). view_step adds (lateral, forward) deltas to the cursor's TWO fine coords (gx,gy) under the facing rotation, then maze_resolve_xy_to_facing (0x35b7) re-derives cellA/cellB from the new fine coords.

evidence.details: 0x37a7: ax=[0x4f9a](facing); branch f0(0x37af): *[bp+4](gx)+=[bp+0xe](lateral); *[bp+6](gy)+=[bp+0x10](forward). f1(0x37c1): *[bp+4]+=[bp+0x10]; *[bp+6]-=[bp+0xe]. f2(0x37d3): *[bp+4]-=[bp+0xe]; *[bp+6]-=[bp+0x10]. f3(0x37e5): *[bp+4]-=[bp+0x10]; *[bp+6]+=[bp+0xe]. Then push coords + z/cellA/cellB and call 0x35b7. The build loop calls 0x3828(param0) etc with forward delta [bp+0x10] via the per-depth advance. findings.claim: The BUILD depth loop (view_render_corridor_frame 0x4c60) runs the BUILD depth counter 0x5040 = 0,1,2,3 (cmp [0x5040] < [0x521e]; 0x521e=4 set at 0x4c3f). depthField on each emitted span = the BUILD depth counter directly (depthField = d, 0-based). Depth d classifies the cell d steps forward from the party (party + d*forward); DEPTH 0 IS THE PARTY'S OWN CELL (its immediate forward edge), so a wt=2 span at depthField 0 is legitimate. This DIRECTLY refutes classify.ts's d=1..4 loop (which starts at depthField 1 and cannot produce the lookback frame's depthField-0 wall). NOTE: at the very top of the BUILD loop there is also an entry-time view_step at 0x4c17 with forward delta -1 (0xffff) — a one-cell pull-BACK that establishes the depth-0 origin; the net effect is that depth d reads cell = party + d*forward (verified empirically below).

evidence.details: 0x4c5a: [0x5040]=0; 0x4c60: cmp [0x5040],[0x521e]; jl body; jmp 0x51f4(flush). 0x4c3f: [0x521e]=4. Per-depth view_step at 0x4c8a (forward delta=1 push, lateral=0). Entry pull-back at 0x4c17-0x4c39 (view_step forward=0xffff). LIVE span lists (maze-classify-probe + the dump in /tmp): facing0 frame (party cellA5,cellB7) emits ONE wt=1 (door) span at depthField 2 — and N[cellA7,cellB7]=3 (a door) is exactly 2 cells forward (cellA 5->7), confirming depthField d == cells-forward d (NOT d+1). facing2-lookback frame (party cellA5,cellB7 walking -cellA) emits wt=2 spans at depthField 0,1,2,3 — the depthField-0 span (x0=136 seam=10) is the party's own cell's solid side wall.

findings.claim: The three primary slots are produced by classifier 0x3828 with three side params: FRONT/center = 0x3828(param 0) -> slot[0x5220]; LEFT-side = 0x3828(param 0xffff) -> slot[0x5226]; RIGHT-side = 0x3828(param 1) -> slot[0x5228]. The two CORNER slots are 0x3c11(param 0) -> slot[0x5222] (corner-L) and 0x3dce(param 0) -> slot[0x5224] (corner-R). EDGE-SELECTION inside 0x3828 (after the optional lateral view_step) is a 4-way facing dispatch on [0x4f9a] (0x3ab3): facing0 reads N (+0x60) of the cell (0x3a51); facing1 reads W (+0x120) (0x3a68); facing2 calls helper 0x36dd which resolves the cell with gy-1 and reads N (+0x60) of that neighbour (= the cell's own -cellA / 'south' edge); facing3 calls helper 0x3742 which resolves with gx-1 and reads W (+0x120) of that neighbour (= the -cellB / 'east' edge). The wall field is a 2-bit value (0=open, 2=solid stone; 1/3 = door/special edges); a door (1/3) is re-classified via the +0x1f8 (4-bit) / +0x378 (2-bit orientation) decoration tables + a 16-way and 13-way jump table (codes 4..0xe) for the wall_emit_quad/corner shape. For the front slot the classifier returns 0 (open passage -> emitter early-returns, no span) or 2 (solid). The SIDE slots (param 0xffff / 1): the classifier FIRST does a lateral view_step (0x3828 0x3839-0x3854 calls 0x37a7 with [bp+0xe]=side param as the lateral delta) to the adjacent cell, THEN reads that cell's forward-facing wall with the same facing dispatch. So left-side / right-side = the forward wall of the cell one step to the party's left / right ('is there a wall down the side passage').

evidence.details: 0x3828 entry: cmp [bp+0xe],0; jne (do lateral view_step 0x3854 via 0x37a7 with [bp+0xe]=lateral) else jmp 0x38ba (front, no lateral step). 0x38ba cell-index. Facing dispatch 0x3ab3: f0->0x3a51 (read +0x60 N), f1->0x3a68 (read +0x120 W), f2->0x3a7f (call 0x36dd), f3->0x3a99 (call 0x3742). 0x36dd: [bp+6]val-1 (gy-1) -> resolve -> read +0x60. 0x3742: [bp+4]val-1 (gx-1) -> resolve -> read +0x120. Decoration override: 0x3ac7 reads +0x1f8 (4-bit special, [bp-6]) + 0x378 (2-bit orient, [bp-8]); if (orient == facing) || special==6 || special<=0xc the +0x1f8 value indexes the 16-way jump table @0x3bed (cs:[bx-0x7ed7]) producing codes 4/5/6/7/8/9/0xa/0xb/0xc/0xd/0xe; otherwise the raw 2-bit field stands. Build-loop call sites: 0x4d1c(param0->0x5220), 0x4d70(param0xffff->0x5226), 0x4d8c(param1->0x5228); 0x4d38 0x3c11(0->0x5222), 0x4d54 0x3dce(0->0x5224).

findings.claim: The CORNER classifiers 0x3c11 (corner-L -> slot[0x5222]) and 0x3dce (corner-R -> slot[0x5224]) share 0x3828's structure but resolve the wall ORIENTATION differently: after reading the edge field they read +0x378 (2-bit orientation), compute (orient+1)%4 (0x3d5b: inc ax; idiv 4) and compare to facing [0x4f9a]; the 13-way jump table @0x3dc4 (cs:[bx-0x7cfa]) then maps the +0x1f8 special-4 value to corner-types 4/5/6/7/8/9/0xa/0xb/0xc/0xd (the [bp+6] corner-type fed to wall_emit_corner 0x45b4). Corner-type 9 = the plain SOLID side-wall (the corridor wt=2 path, span_append @0x4720). For a plain solid wall with no decoration the corner classifier returns 2; the door/decoration cells return the higher codes. The asymmetric frame's corner-R = 2 (settle) / 4 (mid-render) is the orientation-dependent door code for the wall down the right passage. The corner emit sites (0x4e61 corner-L, 0x4ebd corner-R) are GATED by the front gate [bx+0x508a]==1 (set when the forward cell is solid), so corner walls draw only where the corridor is bounded ahead.

evidence.details: 0x3c11 structure mirrors 0x3828 (lateral step gate 0x3c19, cell-index 0x3c60, facing dispatch 0x3edd-style, edge read +0x60/+0x120). Orientation: 0x3d49 read +0x378 (2-bit); 0x3d5b inc; idiv 4 -> (orient+1)%4 in [bp-4]; 0x3d65 cmp [bp-4],[0x4f9a]; jne skip; else +0x1f8 value -> 13-way jump table @0x3dc4 producing di=4..0xd. Return di. 0x3dce (overlay/corner-R) is the same shape with the W-first edge order (0x3e7f reads +0x120 first). LIVE: facing3-leftturn slot[0x5222]=4, facing1-asym slot[0x5224]=2/4 (door orientation); facing0 corner slots=0 (open corridor). Emit gate: 0x4e1d cmp [bx+0x508a],1; jne skip corner-L emit.

findings.claim: The per-depth side-wall SPAN is emitted at EVERY depth where the corridor is BOUNDED (>=1 physical side solid), and the SCREEN-SIDE (left seam-base 12 / right seam-base 10) is chosen by PARITY ALTERNATION, NOT by which physical side is geometrically solid. PROOF: the lookback frame's corridor is solid on ONE side only (W[cellA,cellB+1]=2 for all 4 forward cells) and OPEN on the other (W[cellA,cellB]=0, a parallel passage), yet the engine emits a wt=2 wall at depthField 0,1,2,3 with seams 10,13,12,15 = depthField + {right:10, left:12} -> screen-sides R,L,R,L alternating. If the side were chosen by geometry, only the solid (+cellB) side would emit and the screen-side would NOT alternate. The frame parity is [0x521a] = (gx+gy+facing)%2 (0x4c45) and a per-span parity [0x521c] = (gx+gy+facing+depth)%2 recomputed per depth (0x4c6c). classify.ts's current model ('select one side by parity, emit ONLY if THAT specific side is solid') is WRONG for one-sided corridors — it drops the depths where parity selects the open side. The correct rule: emit at depth d iff (left-side-solid OR right-side-solid) for the bounded corridor; the seam screen-side = parity-alternation.

evidence.details: 0x4c45 frame parity: ax=[0x4fa4]+[0x4fa2]+[0x4f9a]; idiv 2; [0x521a]=dx. 0x4c6c per-span parity: ax=(gx+gy+facing)+[0x5040]; idiv 2; [0x521c]=dx. LIVE lookback (party cellA5 cellB7 facing2, parity 0): wt=2 spans seam10@df0, seam13@df1, seam12@df2, seam15@df3 -> with seamIdx=depthField+sideBase{left:12,right:10}: 10=0+10(R), 13=1+12(L), 12=2+10(R), 15=3+12(L) = R,L,R,L. GEOMETRY (tools/libretro/maze-classify-probe.ts sides): forward cells (cellA 5,4,3,2 at cellB7): W[cellA,cellB+1]=2 ALL depths (one solid side), W[cellA,cellB]=0 ALL depths (other side OPEN). Hence one physical side solid, but spans at all 4 depths alternating screen-side -> alternation is NOT geometric. (Confirms the existing seam law corner-type9-seamidx-law from maze-span-build.json, and the validated alternation in classify.ts's HEADER — but corrects the EMISSION condition.)

classify_projection_law.coords: cell index = z*64 + cellA*8 + cellB. cellA = the ×8 axis (DGROUP 0x4f9e), cellB = the ×1 axis (DGROUP 0x4fa0). Party fields the port should consume: {cellA, cellB, z, facing}. (The fine coords gx/gy and the 12-region cur_cell are internal to the engine's fine-coordinate motion and are NOT needed to classify — classify works directly on cell coords.)
classify_projection_law.lateral_step_right: right-neighbour delta = forward rotated CW: f0=(0,+1), f1=(-1,0), f2=(0,-1), f3=(+1,0). left = negate.
classify_projection_law.edge_read: For a cell (cellA,cellB,z) and facing, the FORWARD edge field (the wall you'd cross stepping forward): f0 = N[cellA,cellB]; f1 = W[cellA,cellB]; f2 = N[cellA,cellB] (own -cellA edge, via the gy-1 neighbour resolve = same cell's north); f3 = W[cellA,cellB] (own -cellB edge). [Out-of-grid neighbour reads as solid=2.] N = +0x60 grid, W = +0x120 grid, 2 bits/cell MSB-first, cell index as above.
classify_projection_law.depth_loop: for d = 0..3 (depthField = d): viewCell = party + d*forward. front = edge_read(viewCell, facing). left-side = edge_read(viewCell + leftDelta, facing). right-side = edge_read(viewCell + rightDelta, facing). (left/right-side are the FORWARD wall of the lateral-neighbour cell, NOT the side edge of viewCell.) Solid = field>=1 treated as blocking (2=stone, 1/3=door).
classify_projection_law.side_emission: Emit a side-wall span at depth d iff the corridor is BOUNDED at that depth (leftSideSolid OR rightSideSolid). The emitted SCREEN-SIDE (seam-base left:12 / right:10) is chosen by PARITY ALTERNATION: side = ((d + fram(parity)) % 2 == 0) ? one : other, framparity = (gx+gy+facing)%2 [for cell coords, (cellA+cellB+facing)%2 is the tracking proxy validated for these frames]. NOT by which physical side is solid. seamIdx = depthField + sideBase (corner-type9 law from maze-span-build.json).
classify_projection_law.depth_bound_occlusion: The loop always runs d=0..3 (fixed bound 0x521e=4). A solid FORWARD edge at depth d occludes deeper cells (the corridor is blocked) — the front gate [0x508a] drives the front-wall + corner emits; past a solid front the deeper side-walls are not visible. (The exact gate-seeding -> emission map for the corner/floor/ceiling slots is in maze-span-build.json build-depth-loop-and-slot-emitters; the slot->span path is already 100% validated via the live-span-read.)

how_classify_ts_should_change.1_coordinate_binding: Rename the party fields: the ×8 axis is cellA (current code's `y`), the ×1 axis is cellB (current code's `x`). Verify @wiz6/data Party: whichever field feeds the ×8 multiplier must be the engine's 0x4f9e. cellIndex(x,y,z) currently computes z*64 + y*8 + x — KEEP the formula but ensure the field bound to `y` (×8) is 0x4f9e and `x` (×1) is 0x4fa0. The current cellEdges N/W algebra assumes facing0=+y; that matches if y=cellA. Audit the asym fixture (facing 1) against the live slot codes to lock the binding.
how_classify_ts_should_change.2_depth_loop_starts_at_0: Change the loop from `for (let d = 1; d <= DEPTH_BOUND; d++)` to `for (let d = 0; d < DEPTH_BOUND; d++)` (DEPTH_BOUND=4), with depthField = d (0-based). viewCell = party + d*forward (d=0 is the party's own cell). This is REQUIRED to produce the lookback depthField-0 wt=2 span; the current d=1..4 loop cannot.
how_classify_ts_should_change.3_side_is_lateral_neighbour_forward_wall: Replace cellEdges' left/right side reads. The side slot is NOT the side EDGE of viewCell — it is the FORWARD wall (same facing edge-selector) of the cell one lateral step away: leftSideSolid = edge_read(viewCell + leftDelta, facing) solid; rightSideSolid = edge_read(viewCell + rightDelta, facing) solid. leftDelta/rightDelta per facing as in classify_projection_law.lateral_step_right.
how_classify_ts_should_change.4_emit_if_bounded_not_if_selected_side_s: Replace the emission condition. Current code: `selected = parityAlternation; emit if selectedSideSolid`. Correct: emit a side-wall span at depth d iff (leftSideSolid OR rightSideSolid); the screen-side (which seam base 12/10) is the parity-alternation `selected`. The selected screen-side is INDEPENDENT of which physical side is solid (proven by lookback: one-sided corridor still emits all depths alternating). The `sides[d]` output should carry the alternation-selected screen-side label whenever the corridor is bounded at d.
how_classify_ts_should_change.5_facing_rotation_all_four: The FORWARD_STEP + edge algebra must be correct for all 4 facings (the asym fixture exercises facing 1, lookback exercises facing 2, turn-left exercises facing 3). Use forward (dCellA,dCellB) f0=(+1,0) f1=(0,+1) f2=(-1,0) f3=(0,-1) and the edge_read facing dispatch (N for f0/f2, W for f1/f3, both on the viewCell itself). Validate each facing's slot codes against maze-frames.json.
how_classify_ts_should_change.6_validation_target: Validate classify against the per-frame slot/span data in maze-frames.json: facing0 (door wt=1 @df2), facing2-lookback (wt=2 @df0,1,2,3 = bounded one-sided corridor), facing3-turn-left ([0,4,0,2,0]), facing1-asym ([0,0,2,0,2] left/right-asymmetric). The slot CODES are the direct classifier output; the SPANS additionally validate depth-0 + the emit-if-bounded rule.

asm_anchors.name: frame_parity
asm_anchors.note: [0x521a] = (gx+gy+facing)%2; per-span parity [0x521c] @0x4c6c = (gx+gy+facing+depth)%2.

asm_anchors.name: build_depth_loop
asm_anchors.note: 0x5040 = 0..3; cmp < [0x521e]=4; depthField = d (0-based). depth d reads cell = party + d*forward; depth 0 = party's own cell.

asm_anchors.name: view_step_forward_by_facing
asm_anchors.note: 4-facing rotation of (lateral=[bp+0xe], forward=[bp+0x10]) onto cursor fine coords (gx=[bp+4], gy=[bp+6]); then 0x35b7. f0:+gy fwd; f1:+gx fwd; f2:-gy fwd; f3:-gx fwd.

asm_anchors.name: maze_resolve_fine_to_cell
asm_anchors.note: resolve (gx,gy) -> cellA/cellB via per-region gxBase(+0x1e0)/gyBase(+0x1ec) bounds (0x357a); writes back cursor cell fields + cur_cell [0x4fa6].

asm_anchors.name: fine_in_region_test
asm_anchors.note: candidate region si: gxBase[si]@+0x1e0 <= gx <= +7 AND gyBase[si]@+0x1ec <= gy <= +7; returns si or 0xffff.

asm_anchors.name: classify_front_side
asm_anchors.note: front/side classifier. param [bp+0xe]: 0=front(no lateral step), 0xffff=left, 1=right (lateral view_step then read). cell-index @0x38ba; facing dispatch @0x3ab3 (f0 N+0x60, f1 W+0x120, f2 ->0x36dd, f3 ->0x3742); decoration override via +0x1f8/+0x378 + jump table @0x3bed. Returns 0(open)/2(solid)/4..0xe(door shapes).

asm_anchors.name: classify_corner_L
asm_anchors.note: corner-L classifier -> slot[0x5222]. Same shape as 0x3828 + orientation (orient+1)%4 vs facing (0x3d5b) + 13-way corner-type jump table @0x3dc4 (codes 4..0xd). Feeds wall_emit_corner [bp+6] corner-type.

asm_anchors.name: classify_corner_R
asm_anchors.note: corner-R classifier -> slot[0x5224]; W-first edge order variant of 0x3c11.

asm_anchors.name: edge_read_facing2_helper
asm_anchors.note: facing-2 (and f0 north-from-behind) edge: resolve cell with gy-1 ([bp+6] dec) then read N +0x60 (the cell's own -cellA edge). Returns 2 if forward open (so the edge IS the wall).

asm_anchors.name: edge_read_facing3_helper
asm_anchors.note: facing-3 edge: resolve cell with gx-1 ([bp+4] dec) then read W +0x120 (the -cellB edge).

asm_anchors.name: cell_index_compute
asm_anchors.note: cell = [bp+0xc]<<6 + [bp+0xa]<<3 + [bp+8] = z*64 + cellA*8 + cellB.

asm_anchors.name: party_cellA
asm_anchors.note: the ×8 axis of cell index; fine coord = gy; forward for facing0 = +cellA.

asm_anchors.name: party_cellB
asm_anchors.note: the ×1 axis of cell index; fine coord = gx; forward for facing1 = +cellB.

asm_anchors.name: party_gy
asm_anchors.note: fine coord of cellA.

asm_anchors.name: party_gx
asm_anchors.note: fine coord of cellB.

asm_anchors.name: cur_cell_region
asm_anchors.note: 12-region index (fine-coord resolver output); NOT used by the wall classifier.

asm_anchors.name: maze_block_ptr
asm_anchors.note: near ptr to per-zone wall block; +0x60 N (2b), +0x120 W (2b), +0x43a pit (1b), +0x1f8 special4 (4b), +0x378 orient2 (2b), +0x49a spec1 (1b), +0x1e0 gxBase, +0x1ec gyBase.

asm_anchors.name: slot_walltype_array
asm_anchors.note: 5 words per depth (overwritten each depth; residual = last processed depth): [0]front [1]corner-L [2]corner-R [3]left-side [4]right-side. 0=open, 2=solid, 4..0xe=door/decoration shapes.

asm_anchors.name: depth_counter
asm_anchors.note: build: 0..3; flush: 4..0.

asm_anchors.name: frame_parity
asm_anchors.note: (gx+gy+facing)%2.

asm_anchors.name: front_gate
asm_anchors.note: per-depth byte; ==1 gates the front-wall + corner emits (corridor bounded ahead).

The corner classifier 0x3c11/0x3dce door-orientation -> corner-type (codes 4..0xd) is statically decoded but only the SOLID (code 2) and one door code (4) are live-observed (the stub has limited decoration). The asym frame's corner-R flips 2<->4 between mid-render and settle (door orientation timing). A frame with a clearly decorated corner is needed to fully validate the 13-way corner-type table. Confidence medium for the door-shape codes; HIGH for the open/solid (0/2) corridor path.

PARITY proxy: classify.ts uses (cellA+cellB+facing)%2 as a proxy for the engine's (gx+gy+facing)%2. For all 4 captured frames the party fine coords are gx=127 gy=121 (constant), and cell parity tracks fine parity. A frame at a DIFFERENT fine-coordinate offset (gx/gy not 127/121) is needed to confirm the proxy holds in general — flagged for the port's validation pass. confidence: medium on the proxy.

The asymmetric frame validates the slot CODES (left/right asymmetry) but not an asymmetric wt=2 SPAN (the stub is open ahead of the asym facing, so no settled side-wall span). A reachable T-junction / alcove where one side is solid AND the corridor is bounded ahead (so the asymmetric side wall reaches a wt=2 span) would be the strongest validation; not reachable from the 3-cell stub without loading a different zone. The lookback frame (one-sided bounded corridor) is the closest available and DOES validate the emit-if-bounded rule + depth-0.
caveat_for_prior_findings: CORRECTS docs/re/findings/maze-span-build.json slot-classification-inputs-prong2 and packages/parser/src/maze/classify.ts: (1) the cell-index axes are TRANSPOSED — the ×8 axis is DGROUP 0x4f9e (prior 'x'), the ×1 axis is 0x4fa0 (prior 'y'); cell = z*64 + cellA*8 + cellB with cellA=0x4f9e. (2) The depth loop is 0-based (depthField 0..3), NOT 1..4 — depth 0 is the party's own cell and produces the lookback depthField-0 wall. (3) The side slots read the FORWARD wall of the LATERAL-neighbour cell (lateral view_step then forward-edge read), NOT the side edge of the current cell. (4) The side-wall span is emitted whenever the corridor is BOUNDED (>=1 side solid) with the screen-side chosen by PARITY ALTERNATION independent of which physical side is solid — classify.ts's 'emit selected side only if that side solid' drops spans for one-sided corridors. The seam law (seamIdx = depthField + {left:12,right:10}) and the flush/render path from maze-span-build.json are CONFIRMED unchanged.
